description: An input method that knows your code: pinyin, zhuyin, double pinyin, wubi, Japanese and Korean, in Breezell's editor and chat and, on Windows, in every program.
config.dataPath: The folder with the dictionaries and language models. Empty: the folder the settings page uses (Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\BreezellIME\data, macOS ~/Library/Application Support/BreezellIME/data, Linux ~/.local/share/breezell-ime).
config.layout: The input method used at first. After that, the one you last chose.
config.chineseScript: The script pinyin and double pinyin write. Zhuyin always writes Traditional Chinese.
config.englishInCode: In code, type English outside comments and strings; in comments, strings, or after /// on the line, type your own language.
config.wubiSmartOrder: Wubi: order candidates with the same code by the text around them (off: a fixed order, as in the Jidian table).
config.useSystemHost: Windows: when the system input method is installed, compose in its engine (the models load once, and what it learns is the same everywhere).
config.prediction: Chinese: after you commit text, offer the words that may come next. Digits pick one (zhuyin: Shift+digit), Tab takes the first.
config.learning: Remember the words you pick and the new words you type.
config.dataMirror: Advanced: an https address to download the dictionaries from instead of GitHub (a mirror of the same files). Every file is still checked against its SHA-256.
